# checker

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/internal/checker"
```

Package checker proves structural immutability from Go compiler type information. It follows Go's structural type predicates and checks each component. Shared type obligations form a graph; definite failures propagate to owners. A recursive collection is accepted only when every reachable obligation holds.

## Constants

Names of the process runtime identities in RuntimePath and of the process methods that only the runtime calls.

```go
const (
    ProcessMarker         = "Process"
    PIDType               = "PID"
    StartFunction         = "Start"
    ReserveFunction       = "Reserve"
    StartReservedFunction = "StartReserved"
    ProcMethod            = "Proc"
    ArgsMethod            = "Args"
    RunMethod             = "Run"
    InitMethod            = "Init"
)
```

LibraryPath is the package whose sealed collection implementations are trusted.

```go
const LibraryPath = "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/im"
```

RuntimePath is the package whose supervised process runtime is trusted.

```go
const RuntimePath = "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/proc"
```

## func Contains

```go
func Contains(t types.Type) bool
```

Contains reports whether a type stores a marked value or sealed collection. It runs one query; use Classifier to reuse results across queries.

## func IsCollection

```go
func IsCollection(t types.Type) bool
```

IsCollection reports whether t is one of the library's sealed collection types.

IsLibraryType identifies a library type by package identity and name, not spelling at its use site.

IsOpaque reports whether t is the library's trusted opaque wrapper.


IsRuntimeType identifies a process runtime type by package identity and name, not spelling at its use site.

## func Marked

```go
func Marked(t types.Type) bool
```

Marked reports the presence of either embedded marker, including invalid combinations. It does not prove immutability; Reason checks the complete type contract.

## func MarkerCount

```go
func MarkerCount(t types.Type) int
```

MarkerCount counts direct embedded marker identities, including aliases of the same marker.

## func Process

```go
func Process(t types.Type) bool
```

Process reports the presence of an embedded proc.Process value. A process is not a marked struct.

## func Reason

```go
func Reason(t types.Type) string
```

Reason proves concrete immutable storage or returns a failed component.

## func Scoped

```go
func Scoped(t types.Type) bool
```

Scoped reports the presence of an embedded im.Scoped value, not type validity.

## func Shared

```go
func Shared(t types.Type) bool
```

Shared reports the presence of an embedded im.Shared value, not type validity.

## func Unevaluated

```go
func Unevaluated(info *types.Info, parents map[ast.Node]ast.Node, cache map[ast.Node]bool, node ast.Node) bool
```

Unevaluated identifies operands of compiler\-proved constant expressions. The cache belongs to one pass with fixed type information and parent links. Runtime operation and ownership checks use the same evaluation boundary.

## type Classifier

Classifier caches protected storage and callback queries for one analysis pass. Its zero value is ready for use. Types must not change after their first query. A Classifier must not be used by concurrent passes.

```go
type Classifier struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func \(\*Classifier\) Callable

```go
func (c *Classifier) Callable(t types.Type) bool
```

Callable reports whether t contains a callback contract that carries protected storage.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Contains

```go
func (c *Classifier) Contains(t types.Type) bool
```

Contains reports whether t stores a marked value or a sealed collection.

## type Prover

Prover reuses immutable type obligations within one analysis pass. Its zero value is ready for use. Types must be complete and must not change. A Prover must not be used by concurrent passes.

```go
type Prover struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func \(\*Prover\) Reason

```go
func (p *Prover) Reason(t types.Type) string
```

Reason proves t or returns a component path to a failure. The selected cause can depend on earlier queries; each root message is cached.
